_: Las escenas animadas (lo pidió el usuario: «rehaz las demás animaciones, con esta calidad»): animate_image de PixelLab sobre la escena elegida de cada paso (crudo/<ELEGIDAS>), 4 fotogramas, semilla 7 (11 en las rehechas: tercer campo). anim/<clave>-<i>.png: el 0 es la escena tal cual y del 1 al 4 los de PixelLab. modo: vaiven (0 1 2 3 4 3 2 1) o bucle (1 2 3 4, lo que gira).
lmanos-0: hands rub together under the running tap water, soap foam bubbles, the water stream flows
lmanos-1: hands scrub each other with soap lather under the faucet, water falls and splashes
lmanos-2: hands rub and dry with the paper towel, the towel crumples between the fingers
lepi-0: fingers button up the white lab coat, the hands move closing the button
lepi-1: hands lift the safety goggles up toward the face, the elastic strap stretches
lepi-2: one hand pulls the blue nitrile glove tight over the other wrist, fingers flex
lauto-0: the gloved hand places the glass tools into the wire basket one by one
lauto-1: small puffs of steam rise from the autoclave valve, the pressure gauge needle trembles, the red display blinks
lauto-2: the gloved finger taps the gauge and the needle swings slowly up and down
lflujo-0: fine airflow particles drift down inside the laminar flow hood, the green light blinks
lflujo-1: the gloved hand squeezes the spray bottle trigger, a mist of alcohol sprays out
lflujo-2: gloved hands gently lift and turn the petri dish inside the hood
lmicro-0: gloved hands slide the glass slide slowly under the microscope lens
lmicro-1: only the gloved hand slowly turns the focus knob back and forth; the magnified seed in the circle stays exactly the same, smooth and unchanged
lbal-0: the gloved finger taps the tare button of the scale, the green display flickers
lbal-1: the gloved hand tips the paper envelope and small seeds fall onto the scale, the display digits change
lres-0: the gloved hand drops the used gloves into the yellow biohazard bin, the lid sways
lres-1: the hand in the blue nitrile glove wipes the steel bench with the white cloth back and forth; the glove stays blue the whole time
rosin-0: only the hand slowly turns the temperature knob, the red digits on the small display change; the press plates and the paper stay exactly the same
rosin-1: the hand pulls the press lever down, the heated plates squeeze and golden rosin oozes and drips out slowly between the plates
rosin-2: hands fold and gently pull the parchment paper, the golden rosin spreads
seco-0: hands shake the wooden sieve side to side, fine golden pollen falls onto the paper below
seco-1: hands shake the sieve frame side to side, pollen sifts down onto the paper
seco-2: hands shake the round sieve, fine golden dust falls through the mesh onto the pile
seco-3: the hand scrapes the golden kief together with the plastic card
ice-0: ice water pours from the pitcher into the bucket and splashes over the buds
ice-1: the wooden paddle stirs the icy water in circles, buds and ice swirl
ice-2: hands lift the mesh bag, water drains and drips through the filter into the bucket
ice-3: fingers crumble and spread the wet hash on the drying tray
charas-0: hands gently rub the resinous bud between the palms, the leaves sway
charas-1: fingers roll and rub the dark resin on the palm
charas-2: fingers roll the dark hash ball between them
hash-0: hands hold the folded paper over the hot plate, heat shimmer rises
hash-1: hands turn the screw press handle, the plate presses down on the cloth bundle
moon-0: hot oil bubbles in the small pan on the hot plate, the hand moves the handle slightly
moon-1: chopsticks dip the bud into the golden oil, the oil drips down from it
moon-2: fingers roll the oily bud in the bowl of kief, the kief coats it
moon-3: the hand picks up the golden moonrock and turns it slowly
lava-0: ice water pours from the jug into the washing machine drum onto the buds
lava-1: the water and buds swirl in a circle inside the washing machine drum, the vortex rotates clockwise; hands and machine stay still
lava-2: water flows from the hose into the filter bucket, the water surface ripples
lava-3: hands lift the stacked mesh bags, the water drains and drips down
stat-0: hands shake the metal sieve, fine trichomes fall onto the black tray
stat-1: the hand rubs the cloth on the acrylic sheet, trichomes jump up from the tray toward it
stat-2: hands move the charged acrylic plate above the tray, trichomes float up and stick to it
stat-3: the hand scrapes the trichomes off the acrylic plate with the card, golden dust falls
mani-0: hands hold the branch, the scissors open and snip the fan leaves
mani-1: the scissors open and close trimming the bud, small leaves fall
mani-2: the scissors snip around the bud, the hand turns the bud, trimmings fall onto the tray
